mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact Legendre pair, positive continuum reduced-gap integral and isotropic inversion, cutoff identities and deterministic finite quadratures; complete Q=2,4,8,16 homogeneous carrier sectors respond trivially to uniform gravity and square-root-like to a declared differential probe.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: SymPy exact positive-real symbolic identities; mpmath 50-decimal quadrature; NumPy binary64 Hermitian eigensystems.
mathematics.conventions: E>=0, a>0, pmax=a/K; Delta is half-level-splitting divided by dipole moment, not raw mode DOS. Original carrier fixed-Q matrices use stated positive-frequency RWA and normal ordered pair interaction, m=1, unit volume.
non_claims: No gravitational dipole source or reduced-gap population is derived from the original scalar action.
No independent prediction of a0, Newton normalization, local long-range restoring force, abundance or halo.
Finite-mode fixed-Q examples are not continuum spatial solutions.
Continuum identities are proved separately; finite quadrature does not prove them.
